Your career oportunity (from 15.09.2026)

You combine strong, hands-on software testing skills with a practical understanding of AI-driven product features and modern AI-supported QA workflows? Also you like to ensure reliable releases across web and/or backend systems, while also contributing to quality strategies for AI-enabled functionality? Then this position might be the perfect fit for you!

Your Mission

  • You own our test strategy end-to-end—and you continuously improve it across both manual and automated testing as we grow.
  • You design, execute, and maintain test cases that cover new features, regressions, and the “it’ll never happen” edge cases.
  • You build reliable automated tests (E2E and API) and you keep them healthy in CI/CD—stable, meaningful, and easy to maintain.
  • You partner closely with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements early, tighten acceptance criteria, and prevent defects before they ship.
  • You define quality signals and metrics that create real release confidence—not just a gut feeling.
  • You raise the bar for AI-feature quality where relevant, including:
    - You test robustness across varied inputs (ambiguous prompts, noisy data, unexpected user behavior).
    - You check safety, privacy, and unintended outputs in line with product requirements.

Requirements

Your Superpowers

  • Your Superpowers
    • You’ve worked in software testing / QA engineering in cross-functional teams and you know what great collaboration looks like.
    • You’re strong in test design, exploratory testing, and defect investigation—you enjoy finding root causes, not just symptoms.
    • You have solid hands-on experience with test automation (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) and API testing (e.g., Postman, Bruno).
    • You’re comfortable with CI/CD and version control (e.g., Git and GitHub/GitLab pipelines) and you treat testing as part of delivery.
    • You understand modern software delivery practices like shift-left QA, code reviews, observability, and documentation—and you apply them pragmatically.
    • You have working knowledge of AI/ML or LLM-powered features and you can translate that into practical quality checks.
    • You communicate clearly and think pragmatically—you balance quality, speed, and risk to help the team ship responsibly.
  • Nice to Have
    • You’ve tested AI/LLM features before (prompt variations, guardrails, unexpected outputs, evaluation approaches).
    • You bring exposure to performance testing and/or security testing basics.

Benefits

Our Promise

🐦Flexibility & mobility

  • Flexible working hours and location-independent mobile working, supported by a Germany-wide rail pass (Deutschlandticket) subsidized with 29 euros
  • 30 days of annual leave (including 24 and 31 December) plus additional days off (wedding, relocation, birth)
  • One volunteering day for a social project that is close to your heart

💛Health & prevention

  • Stay fit with Jobrad and the sports offerings from Hansefit or EGYM Wellpass
  • Full access to everything our mental health partner Bloom has to offer
  • You also benefit from supplementary company health insurance from Allianz
  • A monthly professional shoulder and neck massage at our Hannover office

  • An annual learning budget, currently 800 euros, for courses, books, or coaching
  • Regular feedback and development conversations to support you in reaching your career goals

  • Sensational summer and Christmas parties as well as regular team events

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
description: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d) Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter. Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner. Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen. Deine Verantwortung Strategie und Beratung Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit. Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor. Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen. Kampagnen und Besetzung Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach. Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt. Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand. Daten und Weiterentwicklung Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung schärfst du unsere Methodik weiter. Dein Profil Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldienstleistung oder Inhouse. Beratungsstärke: Du triffst mit deinen Fragen den Kern, denkst in Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass Entscheider mitgehen. Vertriebsbereitschaft: Neue Kunden zu gewinnen gehört für dich dazu und schreckt dich nicht ab. Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kampagnendaten, erkennst Muster und handelst danach. Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst dich selbst, hältst nach Rückschlägen Kurs und misst dich an Ergebnissen. Zum Hintergrund: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg – wir schauen auf Können und Antrieb, nicht auf den Titel. Erfahrung im Recruiting ist willkommen, aber nichts, was wir dir nicht beibringen könnten. Unser Angebot Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Fixgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision, die nicht gedeckelt ist. Unbefristet vom ersten Tag an: Wir planen langfristig – in einem Markt, der stabil wächst. Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant. Das Tempo bestimmst du. Einarbeitung mit Struktur: Umfassendes Onboarding, Trainings zu Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb, dazu feste Feedbackrunden. Ausstattung auf Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Fitness auf unsere Kosten: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl. Gut versorgt: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü. Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Der Ablauf Bewerben in zwei Minuten – Lebenslauf genügt, kein Anschreiben nötig. Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Wenn du Recruiting nicht abarbeiten, sondern gestalten willst: Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Video Journalist, News and Enterprise
description: <div class="content-intro"><div id="labeledImage.LOCATION" class="WIFG" data-automation-id="decorationWrapper"> <div class="WNHJ"> <div id="labeledImage.LOCATION--uid38" class="WE-Y WMXY WBAB WF0Y" data-automation-id="responsiveMonikerInput" data-metadata-id="labeledImage.LOCATION" data-uxi-form-item-child-list-index="0"> <div class="WJ-Y"> <p><strong>The <a href="https://www.nytco.com/mission-and-values/" target="_blank"><u>mission</u></a> of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.&nbsp;</strong></p> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">The New York Times is continuing to expand its video journalism, identifying compelling visual stories across the depth and breadth of our report. We share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting and pioneering Visual Investigations, and showcase the expertise of Times reporters around the world.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Video Journalist to focus on breaking and continuing news coverage in a range of visual formats, from short-form videos to multimedia articles to groundbreaking interactives.</p> <p>You are an experienced reporter and international field producer who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has a track record of deploying to cover high-stakes stories around the world. You are a gifted storyteller, both with the camera and in the editing room, who can efficiently juggle multiple projects at a time. You are a self-starter and quick thinker who is able and eager to jump on top stories with fresh ideas for original visual news coverage. We are looking for an idea generator, who’s constantly pitching stories and developing sources, as well as someone with impeccable news instincts, ethics and judgement. You should be eager to collaborate with other journalists and feature them on camera.</p> <p>You should be able to work independently, secure access and deliver impactful and immediate reporting that drives the story forward.</p> <p>Please note, this is not an entry-level position and it is not a position for someone who is interested in producing documentaries.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is an in-office position based in London and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p>Expertly and independently carry out all aspects of video production, including research, reporting, writing, shooting, producing, editing and publishing.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Consistently pitch coverage opportunities, and help manage big projects in a range of formats, including linear videos and interactives, and overseeing the work of others as needed.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Respond to breaking news events, and producing original video stories, both remotely and in the field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use wire services, on the ground sources, social media and other open source tools to find and verify newsworthy video footage.</p> </li> <li> <p>Set up and monitor live video feeds, as needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Produce high-quality video journalism quickly and independently, while also guiding and mentoring more junior staff members as they develop and report original story ideas.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of <a href="https://www.nytco.com/company/mission-and-values/" target="_blank"><u>journalistic independence</u></a> and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.</p> </li> <li> <p>This role reports to a Senior Producer, Video.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Basic Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Proven deep journalism experience in a digital video newsroom.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Extensive professional experience in all aspects of the video production process, including strong writing and reporting skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Expert working knowledge of U.S. and international news events, with a proven track record covering breaking news around the world. Emphasis will be on Europe, the Middle East and Africa.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in reporting and producing video in complex news environments, such as conflict zones or other hostile environments, under the pressure of tight deadlines in the field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong editorial judgment and writing skills, with a passion for finding original, visual journalism opportunities in competitive news moments.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong organizational skills, with the ability to supervise other video journalists and schedules, direct field crews, and hire and manage freelancers when necessary.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with Canon video camera systems and the ability to shoot video in the field and in-studio.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in shooting and editing in Premiere Pro.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with UGC verification.</p> </li> <li> <p>Foreign language skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>A broad network of well-placed story sources and production contacts, both in the U.S. and internationally.</p> </li> <li> <p>General knowledge of legal, ethical, copyright and usage issues for third-party and acquired visuals, and the ability to find exclusive images to help drive our reporting.</p> </li> <li> <p>Willingness and flexibility to travel on short notice, and also work evenings and weekends as needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong time management skills and the ability to juggle multiple assignments at a time.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with others, including, often, correspondents in the field.</p> </li> </ul> <p>REQ-020530</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span data-sheets-root="1"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Additional Compensation and Benefits</strong></span><br><br>For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs. <br><br>For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.</span></span></p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:</strong></p> <p>We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.</p> <p>If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available&nbsp;<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">here</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>The New York Times Company will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email ----- Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.</p> <p>For information about The New York Times' privacy practices for job applicants, click <a href="https://nytco-assets.nytimes.com/2020/06/NYT_Applicant_Privacy_Policy.pdf">here</a>.</p> <p>Please beware of fraudulent job postings. title: Senior Talent Partner, Tech
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Eucalyptus</h3> <p>We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Eucalyptus is now part of Hims &amp; Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.<br><br></p> <h3>Our Growth Story:</h3> <ul> <li>Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets</li> <li>Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS</li> <li>Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.</li> </ul></div><p><strong>How we think about talent</strong></p> <p>At Euc, talent is the growth engine behind everything we do. We are not here to fill roles or keep pipelines warm. We go where candidates are, earn their attention, and create a hiring experience that converts.</p> <p>We move fast. Really fast. Because the best people don’t stay on the market for long, and neither do we.</p> <p>Here's how we think:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Sourcing is king.</strong> The best engineers, product leaders, and technical minds are not applying; they are found. We go outbound, get creative, and meet technical talent where they live (GitHub, open-source communities, and technical events).</li> <li><strong>Process mastery.</strong> Hiring at pace creates friction. We spot bottlenecks in code assessments and interview loops early, clearing the path before they slow the team down.</li> <li><strong>The recruiting funnel is a sales funnel.</strong> Drop-off is a signal. We track it, understand it, and fix it. Every stage is a chance to win or lose exceptional technical talent.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity drives better outcomes.</strong> New tools, new tactics, and new ideas. If something might work, we test it. Better technical hiring comes from constantly evolving our approach.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s next?</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are continuing to scale our UK business at pace, expanding our core technology, engineering, product, and data functions. To support this growth, we are looking for a Senior Talent Partner, Tech (12-month Fixed-Term Contract) focused on hiring across our Engineering, Product, and Data teams.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role for someone who can build high-quality engineering pipelines from scratch, navigate complex technical requirements, partner with senior engineering leaders, and consistently land top-tier talent.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>This hands-on role sits within the Talent team on an up to 12-month Fixed-Term Contract (FTC), working alongside the Talent Acquisition Manager and broader Talent team. The role manages technical hiring processes end to end, delivering critical headcount during a growth phase for Eucalyptus.</p> <p>The primary focus is hiring across the UK Tech organisation, covering engineering, product management, design, and data functions as the platform scales.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Full-lifecycle hiring:</strong> Manage end-to-end recruitment for UK technical roles (Software Engineers, Tech Leads, Product Managers, Data Scientists) from kick-off to offer acceptance.</li> <li><strong>Proactive sourcing:</strong> Identify talent using technical community research, GitHub, referrals, and targeted channel outreach.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder partnership:</strong> Work directly with Engineering Leaders to clarify technical specs, calibrate candidate quality, design effective assessments, and maintain hiring momentum.</li> <li><strong>Funnel evaluation:</strong> Review performance across sourcing, screening, and interview stages to identify and resolve bottlenecks.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline reporting:</strong> Build hiring reports that track pipeline health, conversion rates, and time-to-hire across technical roles.</li> <li><strong>Channel optimisation:</strong> Test and measure sourcing channels and outreach strategies to improve candidate response and conversion rates.</li> <li><strong>Process HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it. Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity. Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard. That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day. We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong. Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out . Great means that: the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and those outcomes show up in revenue. What you're here to do: Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks. Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours. Take on AI review. It's a deep agentic system (evals, flows, failure modes) and "good redline" isn't a pass/fail, which is what makes it hard. It also spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place. Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using. Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary. Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word. We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub . WHO WE LOOK FOR Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit. To succeed here: Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day. Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles. On top of that, you have been part of a journey where: You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once. You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies. You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.* You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build. You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks. BONUS #1: You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production. BONUS #2: Legal tech or contracting experience. *What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time. This job likely isn’t for you if: You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful. You think of AI as something the engineers deal with. You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams. You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it. You'd rather run the process than talk to customers. You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser. Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth. Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • Take on AI review. It's a deep agentic system (evals, flows, failure modes) and "good redline" isn't a pass/fail, which is what makes it hard. It also spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

  • BONUS #1: You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • 4+ years shipping AI/ML products in a startup or applied industry setting, with recent hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of the four skill areas above.

  • Strong product and customer instincts: comfort joining customer calls, watching session recordings, and letting real workflows shape what you work on.

  • Sharp evaluation judgement: benchmarks where they exist, vibes and quick prototypes where they don't, and the taste to know which is appropriate.

  • Experience building datasets for evaluation or training, including the pipeline work that goes with it.

  • Deeply curious about agents and excited about reshaping how software is built.

  • A Masters or PhD in a relevant computational field.

  • Direct experience with coding agents or code-generation systems.

  • Background in RL, bandits, or other outer-loop optimisation frameworks applied to LLMs.

  • Partner with product and engineering on near-term shipping problems by bringing research rigour.

  • Pull a recent paper apart, work out what's actually transferable to our platform, and turn it into a concrete experiment.

You’ll partner closely with our FP&amp;A team, supporting business leaders with insight on how our markets are performing, how members are behaving, and helping drive decisions on growth strategy from investment choices to location expansion. You’re comfortable building and owning transformations end-to-end, not just querying existing tables.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement - you’re a trusted partner, not just a data builder, and can distill complexity into clear, actionable insight.</li> <li>Strategic mindset with strong commercial instincts - you understand how businesses operate and where data can create leverage.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise and adapt across strategic and operational needs - whether it's analysing member behaviour or building a performance snapshot for FP&amp;A and Exec, you switch gears with ease.</li> <li>Growth mindset - eager to learn, challenge assumptions, and push boundaries, not just execute tasks.</li> </ul> <p><em>Desirables</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with BI Tools &amp; notebooking environments (We use Omni &amp; HEX).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with dbt.</li> <li>Experience working in or around ERP/finance systems (e.g. Oracle, SAP), with an understanding of reporting transformation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Working experience of AI tools in day-to-day work (we use Claude).</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Benefits…</strong></p> <p>Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>About the Revenue team </strong><br>The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimisation to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.<br><br><strong>About the role</strong><br>We’re looking for a Director, Key &amp; Enterprise Sales in the UK to lead this business and help shape Affirm’s long-term growth in retail. Reporting to the Head of International Sales, this leader will oversee 5 senior Account Executives and work with some of Affirm’s most strategic merchants across fashion, beauty, apparel, sporting goods, electronics, furniture, travel and other lifestyle categories in the UK and Europe.</p> <p><br>This leader will evolve our UK Go To Market (GTM) strategy, build executive relationships, guide complex commercial opportunities, and turn strategy into measurable business results. They will lead a high-impact team and partner across the business to help Affirm win, launch, and grow strategic merchant relationships.<br><br><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Lead and mentor a team of senior Account Executives, creating alignment, accountability, and consistent execution against regional and company priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own executive stakeholder management for the region: set the narrative, surface risks early, recommend decisions, and drive resolution with senior leadership; lead executive-level negotiations with strategic partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with senior leadership to define and evolve the UK/Europe enterprise GTM strategy and operating model, including segmentation, coverage, merchant prioritization, deal governance, and standards for how Affirm wins, launches, and grows strategic partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Influence broader commercial strategy by bringing market insights, merchant feedback, and competitive trends into business planning, prioritization, and investment decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the regional decision-maker for complex commercial opportunities, balancing merchant needs, risk considerations, operational constraints, and long-term business objectives to drive successful outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Recruitment &amp; Process Ownership: Own talent planning, hiring, and calibration processes for the region, building a high-performing organization and ensuring consistent leadership standards across the team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bring structure and innovation to sales execution, pipeline management, and deal strategy, driving efficiency and effectiveness across the team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own end-to-end outcomes from signature through launch and first-year expansion, including cross-channel, cross-geography, and multi-brand growth; hold cross-functional partners accountable to shared milestones, resolve escalations, and ensure delivery against commercial and customer experience objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hold your team accountable for performance, providing immediate and thoughtful coaching to drive continuous improvement, and build a strong team culture aligned with Affirm’s values.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as a senior thought leader at industry events and conferences, advocating for our mission and strengthening our position in the market.</p> </li> <li> <p>Travel regularly to lead executive engagements to accelerate AE deal cycles, and facilitate team planning sessions and offsites.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>10+ years of solution selling experience, including 5+ years leading high-performing enterprise sales teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strategic and hands-on sales leader with a deep understanding of enterprise sales and complex deal structures.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience shaping operating models, sales processes, or commercial strategies that scale beyond an individual team or territory.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience setting regional/department strategy, translating it into operating rhythms, and scaling a team/org to deliver sustained results.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional execution across Product/Legal/Risk/CS for complex enterprise partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Operational &amp; Pipeline Rigor: Deep expertise and strict ownership of CRM/Salesforce hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and sales methodologies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record of selling into large, enterprise merchants across numerous industries, ideally with experience in Retail, Travel and/or the Credit and Payments landscape.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong alignment with Affirm’s mission, with a passion for building financial products that improve lives. Ideally, you have used our product and understand its value to merchants and consumers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong executive presence and ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and at major brands.</p> </li> <li> <p>An active networker who can broker warm leads and open doors to new opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>A structured, organized leader who brings new ways of thinking and managing to the team.</p> </li> <li> <p>A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive initiatives forward.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong coach and mentor who holds the team accountable and provides real-time, constructive feedback to improve performance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Willingness to travel regularly to support deal acceleration, industry events, and team collaboration.</p> </li> </ul> <div> <div> <p><strong>Base Pay Grade</strong> - N</p> <p><strong>Equity Grade</strong> - 7</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes the annual base pay and the sales incentive target.&nbsp;</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidised medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).</p> <p>GBR base pay range per year: £120,000 - £168,000</p> <p>Location: UK Remote&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.</span></p> <p class="p1">[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Recruiter - EMEA (6m Contract - Inside IR35 Day Rate)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>London / Hybrid (2-3 days per week in office, Soho)<strong><br>Duration: </strong>6 months initially<strong><br>Day Rate: </strong>£400-£500 per day (Inside IR35)<strong><br>Engagement Method: </strong>Umbrella/PAYEPosition Overview</p> <p><strong>Role Overview:</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment, the company behind PlayStation, is looking for an experienced Senior Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team.</p> <p>This is a broad, high-impact recruiting role supporting hiring across both <strong>Corporate functions</strong> and <strong>Technology and Engineering</strong>. One day you could be partnering with leaders on a specialist corporate search, the next you could be building a talent strategy for a complex engineering team.</p> <p>At SIE, Talent Acquisition is about much more than managing requisitions.</p> <p>Our recruiters are trusted partners to the business. We help leaders understand the talent market, challenge assumptions, shape hiring strategies and make great decisions. We bring external insight into the organisation and create an experience that reflects PlayStation at every stage of the hiring process.</p> <p>You will own your searches from the first conversation with a hiring manager through to offer and close, while building relationships and talent pipelines that extend well beyond today's vacancies.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders across Corporate, Technology and Engineering to understand their teams, priorities and future talent needs.</li> <li>Own full-cycle recruitment across a varied portfolio of roles, from initial intake and market mapping through sourcing, assessment, offer and close.</li> <li>Build hiring strategies rather than relying on applications alone, identifying where the right talent sits and how we should engage them.</li> <li>Proactively identify and engage passive talent, building relationships with people who may become future PlayStation employees.</li> <li>Act as a talent adviser to hiring teams, bringing market intelligence, candidate insight and external perspective into hiring decisions.</li> <li>Challenge hiring assumptions when the market tells us something different, helping teams balance ambition, availability, skills and speed.</li> <li>Recruit across a broad range of disciplines and seniority levels, adapting your approach to different talent markets.</li> <li>Create diverse, high-quality talent pipelines through direct sourcing, referrals, networking and other relevant channels.</li> <li>Run thoughtful candidate conversations that explore capability, motivation, career goals and alignment with the opportunity.</li> <li>Partner closely with HR, Compensation, Finance and other teams to navigate the full hiring process.</li> <li>Guide hiring managers through effective, consistent and inclusive interview and selection processes.</li> <li>Manage offers and negotiations, balancing candidate expectations, internal frameworks and business requirements.</li> <li>Use recruiting data and market insight to understand performance, identify challenges and improve hiring outcomes.</li> <li>Keep candidates informed and engaged throughout the process, including when the answer is no.</li> <li>Contribute to the wider Talent Acquisition team, sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and helping us continuously improve how we hire.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What being a TA Partner means at SIE</strong></p> <p>We are looking for someone who wants to understand the business behind the requisition.</p> <p>You will build credibility with your stakeholders by knowing their organisation, understanding the talent they need and having a point of view on how to find it.</p> <p>You will be comfortable asking questions such as: Do we need this exact profile? Where does this talent exist? What is the market telling us? Is our interview process helping us identify the right person? What will make someone choose PlayStation?</p> <p>You will also recognise that every candidate interaction matters.</p> <p>For many people, a recruiter is their first meaningful interaction with SIE. We want that experience to be informed, human and representative of who we are, whether someone ultimately joins us or not.</p> <p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience owning full-cycle recruitment, ideally within a global technology, entertainment, gaming or similarly complex organisation.</li> <li>Experience recruiting across Technology or Engineering, combined with the ability and interest to recruit across broader Corporate functions.</li> <li>A strong track record of partnering with hiring managers and senior stakeholders rather than operating purely as a recruitment delivery resource.</li> <li>Confidence sourcing and engaging passive candidates in competitive talent markets.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple searches and stakeholder relationships at the same time while maintaining quality and attention to detail.</li> <li>Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills.</li> <li>Sound judgement and the confidence to constructively challenge stakeholders when needed.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Experience using applicant tracking systems and recruiting technology. Experience with Greenhouse is useful but not essential.</li> <li>A data-informed approach to recruiting, with an understanding of metrics such as pipeline health, conversion, time to hire and source effectiveness.</li> <li>A collaborative mindset. We operate as one Talent Acquisition team and expect people to share information, support each other and contribute beyond their own requisitions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What will help you stand out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience recruiting across both Corporate and technical disciplines.</li> <li>Experience hiring software engineering or other specialist technology talent.</li> <li>Experience working within gaming, entertainment, consumer technology or another globally recognised, multi-matrix brand.</li> <li>Strong talent mapping and direct sourcing capability.</li> <li>Experience advising senior leaders on complex or difficult-to-fill searches.</li> <li>An interest in games, entertainment and the technology behind the PlayStation experience.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.playstation.com/legal/careers-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As a Technical Account Manager at Happl, you’ll be the person customers trust to turn their ambitions into reality. You’ll own the technical implementation of Happl across a portfolio of accounts, designing the architecture, building the integrations, and making sure every deployment is intelligent, scalable, and set up to grow.

This role sits at the intersection of customer success, product, and engineering. You’ll work directly with HR, Finance, and key stakeholders to understand what they actually need, then translate those requirements into solutions that genuinely change how their teams experience benefits. You’ll be equally comfortable presenting an architecture to a CTO, configuring a complex data integration, and jumping into a troubleshooting session to get a customer unblocked.

We’re still building this function. That means there’s no rigid playbook to follow, you’ll help write it. If you’re energised by that kind of ownership, and want to shape how a category defining product gets deployed across the world, this is the role for you.


What you’ll be doing

  • Leading end-to-end customer implementations, from discovery and scoping through to go-live and long-term optimisation, taking full ownership of the technical relationship throughout

  • Designing AI-powered solutions tailored to each customer’s benefits structure, HRIS landscape, and people strategy — turning complex requirements into clean, scalable deployments

  • Running structured technical discovery sessions and solution workshops, mapping customer needs to Happl’s capabilities before a single line of configuration is written

  • Owning integrations with HRIS, payroll, and third-party platforms (including REST APIs and webhooks), ensuring seamless, reliable data flows across every customer’s tech stack

  • Building and automating implementation workflows using AI tools, reducing manual effort and raising the consistency and quality of every deployment

  • Acting as the technical escalation point during and after go-live, diagnosing root causes quickly and partnering with Engineering to drive permanent fixes

  • Translating what you learn across implementations into reusable assets — architecture blueprints, playbooks, and internal tooling — that make every future deployment faster and smarter

  • Partnering with Customer Success to ensure adoption is strong post-launch, identifying configuration gaps and opportunities that drive retention and expansion

  • Feeding implementation insights back to Product and Engineering with clarity and evidence, directly influencing the roadmap

  • Analysing configuration and usage data across your account portfolio to spot patterns, flag risks early, and surface opportunities to improve customer outcomes

  • Championing AI-first ways of working — actively exploring tools like Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and bring smarter thinking to every customer engagement

  • Staying genuinely curious about HR tech, benefits trends, and the evolving AI landscape, bringing ideas that keep Happl and its customers ahead of the curve

  • 3+ years in a Technical Account Manager, Implementation Engineer, or Technical Account Manager role within a B2B SaaS environment

  • A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end-to-end — with the technical depth to design robust solutions and the communication skills to bring customers with you

  • Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, and data integrations; comfortable diagnosing issues, building elegant solutions, and documenting them clearly for customers and internal teams

  • Truly AI-native: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and modern no-code platforms in your day-to-day work, and you’re excited about what they unlock in implementation and customer delivery

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts — able to take ambiguous requirements and turn them into clear, well-structured technical plans

  • An excellent communicator who adapts naturally — as confident presenting a solution architecture to a CTO as troubleshooting a configuration issue with an HR admin

  • Highly organised and self-directed, capable of managing multiple concurrent implementations without compromising on quality or customer experience

  • Excited by the prospect of helping build a function from the ground up — you’re energised by defining how things should work, not just following an established path

  • Genuine curiosity about HR technology, employee benefits, and the role AI is playing in reshaping how companies support their people

If you’re energised by the challenge of building (not just operating) you’ll find a lot to love about working here.

raw.title: Chief of Staff
raw.description:
About Cortea

We're Cortea, a European audit-tech company, born in Berlin, rebuilding how audits are done everywhere.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we're at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea's future, and how audits are done.

The Role

As Chief of Staff, you are a core member of the leadership orbit, working directly with Valentin (Co-Founder) to translate high-level vision into operational reality.

You will sit at the intersection of Growth, Strategy, Finance, and Operations. Your mission is to tackle some of our most complex, ambiguous challenges at Cortea: in the first instance, architecting our UK and international expansion. You may also take on other strategic priorities for the business, such as refining our AI-driven unit economics.

This role is a springboard. You will gain a "CEO-level" view of building a category-defining AI company, based in London while working in close, frequent contact with our founders and team in Berlin.

What You'll Do

  • UK Market Building: Spearhead Cortea's UK market entry. Help grow team and presence, working closely with the founders and Berlin team to adapt processes, hiring, and local go-to-market.

  • Founder Force Multiplier: Act as a proxy for the founders in internal and external meetings, ensuring decisions are made and projects stay on track even when the founders aren't in the room

  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact projects from conception to completion. While in the first instance, this role will be focussed on Cortea’s UK market entry, the CoS may also take on other strategic initiatives (e.g. designing an AI-era pricing model or optimising the sales-to-onboarding funnel)

  • Scaling the AI-Native Operating System: Build the repeatable processes, meeting cadences, and communication loops, supercharged with AI agents and automation, that allow Cortea to scale toward €100m+ ARR without losing speed. You'll treat internal workflows as products, deploying AI wherever it removes friction

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience in high-velocity environments (top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking, or a high-growth VC-backed startup)

  • Strategic Operator: You can think at 30,000 feet about market positioning, but you have the grit to dive into a spreadsheet or a legal contract to get a deal over the line

  • Financial Fluency: You have a deep understanding of P&L management, financial modelling, and SaaS metrics

  • Exceptional Communicator: You can distill complex AI concepts and financial data into clear, persuasive narratives for investors and the team

  • High Agency: You don't wait for a playbook; you write it. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of a "zero-to-one" environment

  • Native in English, German is a plus

  • Willingness to travel to Berlin frequently to work in person with the founders and team

  • Right to work in the UK required; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role

How We Work

  • Founder mindset: Everyone acts like a founder. You're encouraged to take on any topic you believe is worth improving, with team and founder support

  • Thoughtful decision-making: Collaborative problem solving, concise written thinking, and deep in-person discussions to reach the best result

  • Speed over perfection: We value progress and learning, preferring strong 80/20 solutions over perfection

  • Feedback & learning: We give and ask for feedback weekly, not monthly

What Success Looks Like

  • In 3 months: You have worked through our UK ops, deployed workflow automations across the company, and offloaded 20% of the founders' highest-priority tasks

  • In 6 months: You have strengthened Cortea's UK operations into a foundation that scales on its own, and you are ready to lead the next big strategic bet

  • In 12 months: You have helped institutionalise the "Cortea Way" in the UK, creating a scalable operational foundation that supports our next major funding milestone

What We Offer

  • Impact: A seat at the table during the most critical growth phase of a well-funded AI startup, with the opportunity to help grow Cortea's UK team and presence

  • Growth: Mentorship from experienced founders and close collaboration across the company

  • Compensation: Competitive salary plus meaningful equity

  • Benefits: 25+ days holiday allowance, pension contribution, private medical insurance

  • Perks: Learning budget, team lunches, off-sites, and regular trips to our Berlin hub

Interview Process

  • Intro call with Gamila (Talent Acquisition Lead at Dawn Capital)

  • Strategy & finance interview, real-world scenario, with Valentin (Co-Founder)

  • Culture interview, values and collaboration fit, with Philipp (Co-Founder)

  • On-site day (Berlin): meet the team and work through a real, current problem

title: Global Onboarding
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role First impressions matter - especially at a company growing as fast as ElevenLabs. As our dedicated onboarding owner, you'll be responsible for the end-to-end new joiner experience globally: from the moment an offer is signed to the point a new hire is fully ramped and connected to the company. You'll partner across People, Talent, Finance, IT, and the broader business to design a globally consistent onboarding journey that reflects who we are - high-velocity, ambitious, and caring. This is a systems-building role: you'll create the infrastructure that ensures every new joiner, in every timezone, hits the ground running. Own the global onboarding program end-to-end - pre-boarding communications, first day experience, first-30/60/90 day frameworks and onboarding feedback. Partner with People Operations & IT to ensure all operational onboarding steps (system access, equipment, compliance documentation) are completed seamlessly across every region. Collaborate with Leads to build team-specific onboarding guides that complement the company-wide program. Design and maintain onboarding materials - welcome tasks, wiki documentation, Leads resources - that stay current as the company evolves. Track and analyze new joiner feedback to continuously improve time-to-productivity and early engagement metrics. Requirements We do not require any formal experience, certifications or degrees. Instead we are seeking individuals who can demonstrate impact in fast-moving environments. We do require: Demonstrated experience owning or significantly contributing to onboarding programs at a fast-growing company, ideally with a global or multi-regional workforce. Strong operational instincts - you enjoy building processes that scale, not just one-off experiences. Highly organised with excellent attention to detail; you can manage multiple simultaneous new joiner cohorts without anything slipping. Collaborative and empathetic communicator - you understand that great onboarding is as much about how people feel as what they know. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
description: The Role's Purpose Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact. The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners. Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth. This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams. What You'll Do Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement. Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact. Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. raw.title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
raw.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives.
